This smartphone UI screen is from the 1-800-Flowers app. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Header Section**:
   - The top bar displays the app name "1-800-Flowers" and a promotional offer of "12% JetCash".
   - There are icons for "Menu" and "Radio" on the right side of the header.

2. **Promotional Banner**:
   - Below the header, there is a yellow banner advertising "25% Off Early Valentine's Orders".

3. **Pop-up Notification**:
   - The main focus of the screen is a pop-up from "JetAnywhere".
   - The pop-up asks if the user made a purchase and instructs them to forward their order confirmation to anywhere@jet.com to receive 12% back in JetCash.
   - There is a "Gotcha!" button to acknowledge and close the pop-up.
